# E7, Part B — the gate on DataRaceBench 1.4.1 (201 kernels)

*Generated by `tools/gate_study.py readout-drb` from run `e7_drb`. Each kernel is one candidate: the file without its OpenMP directive lines is the reference, the file as shipped the candidate, judged by the gate's safety validation several times. A kernel named `-yes` holds a documented data race, one named `-no` none.*

| class | label | kernels | judged | refused in the first run | refused in at least one run | refused in every run |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| threads | yes | 85 | 79 | 66 | 70 | 64 |
| threads | no | 84 | 67 | 7 | 8 | 7 |
| simd-only | yes | 3 | 3 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| simd-only | no | 3 | 3 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| offloading | yes | 12 | 12 | 9 | 9 | 9 |
| offloading | no | 14 | 14 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

**Kernels that start threads on the host, with a documented race:** refused by one call of the gate 66 of 79 (83.5 %, 95 % interval 73.9–90.1 %); in at least one of the runs 70 of 79 (88.6 %, 95 % interval 79.7–93.9 %).
**Without a race:** refused by one call of the gate 7 of 67 (10.4 %, 95 % interval 5.2–20.0 %); in at least one of the runs 8 of 67 (11.9 %, 95 % interval 6.2–21.8 %).

First run's refusals by check (kernels that start threads): no: correctness 7, yes: correctness 1, yes: schedules 2, yes: tsan 63.

### Kernels not judged: 23

- **11** — without its directives it is no sequential program: it does not end, crashes, fails its own assertion or exits with an error code: `DRB074-flush-orig-yes.c (yes, threads)`, `DRB076-flush-orig-no.c (no, threads)`, `DRB121-reduction-orig-no.c (no, threads)`, `DRB184-barrier1-no.c (no, threads)`, `DRB187-barrier2-yes.c (yes, threads)`, `DRB188-barrier3-no.c (no, threads)`, `DRB190-critical-section2-no.c (no, threads)`, `DRB191-critical-section2-yes.c (yes, threads)`, `DRB195-diffusion1-yes.c (yes, threads)`, `DRB198-prodcons-no.c.c (no, threads)`, `DRB199-prodcons-yes.c (yes, threads)`
- **6** — one of DataRaceBench's PolyBench kernels: two source files and a printed run time: `DRB041-3mm-parallel-no.c (no, threads)`, `DRB042-3mm-tile-no.c (no, threads)`, `DRB043-adi-parallel-no.c (no, threads)`, `DRB044-adi-tile-no.c (no, threads)`, `DRB055-jacobi2d-parallel-no.c (no, threads)`, `DRB056-jacobi2d-tile-no.c (no, threads)`

- **1** — a run exceeds the gate's time limit (120 s plain, 300 s under the sanitizer): `DRB065-pireduction-orig-no.c (no, threads)`
